content:
maya: Heads up — product wants a short changelog blurb + migration snippet for the "latency-first" routing opt-in. Release window 2026-04-20. Docs PR needed by 2026-04-16.

noah: I can draft the blurb. What are the exact SDK fields?

kevin: Eng note: new field routing.prefer_latency (boolean). Default false. If true, router favors latency-optimized variants; fallback to cost-optimized if latency can't be met. Known quirk: when a fallback occurs during streaming, a short partial chunk may be emitted before the fallback completes.

liz: Proposed changelog line: "Latency-first routing (opt-in): enable routing.prefer_latency to prefer low-latency model variants. Existing integrations are unchanged."

noah: I'll include tiny JS and Python snippets and a one-line migration note about prefix cache hits. JS snippet: ```js
// JS SDK v2
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'rwk-1', prompt: 'Summarize', routing: { prefer_latency: true } });
```

kevin: Add cache note: enabling prefer_latency may route across model families and reduce prefix/KV cache hit rate temporarily.

liz: Add rollout note: gradual rollout over 48 hours with automatic rollback on error thresholds.

docbot: Branch created: refs/heads/docs/latency-first by noah.

noah: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — draft changelog, JS+Python snippets, migration anchor /docs/migrate/latency-first. Tagging @kevin for tech signoff and @liz for copy.

kevin: quick review done. small clarifying edit on partial stream timing.

liz: copy polish done. target merge 2026-04-15 after staging preview.

maya: thanks all — CS and support will get the known-issue note post-merge. Closing thread.
